svg.title: Workload: everything open for one person — SoftTrack web design mockup (#127)
svg.desc: A Workload tab on the profile page lists the person’s open tickets grouped by team, only in teams the viewer shares with them, with per-team counts and points computed in the database.

svg.text: One endpoint in app_softtrack (workload reads tickets, so it lives with the work, not in identity), paginated per team group. Tenancy sits inside the query: assigned to them AND in
a team the viewer belongs to, never a post-filter.
